lines.zh: 我游过一片海泡菜，慢下来。
lines.en: I swim over a patch of pickles and slow down.

lines.zh: 身上有绿，藏在沙里更好。
lines.en: There's green on me. Better hidden in sand.
I keep to the bottom of the warm water.

lines.zh: 尾一摆，沙子盖住我的背。
lines.en: One tail flick and sand covers my back.
I circle the pickle cluster.
The light in the shallows is warm.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，反正不赶时间。
lines.en: I swim slowly. No rush.

lines.zh: 我穿过那片绿，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I pass through the green, nearly invisible.
There's a green rim on my fin.
The swell pushes me shoreward and I angle away.
I head where the pickles grow.

lines.zh: 这底下的沙，软得像被子。
lines.en: The sand here is soft as a quilt.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁缝，一节一节游。
lines.en: I thread the reef gaps in stages.

lines.zh: 水面上的船影，我避开了。
lines.en: I avoid the boat's shadow on the surface.

lines.zh: 我在暖水里待着，不想动。
lines.en: I stay in the warm water, unwilling to move.

lines.zh: 我长得像海泡菜，味道却不像。
lines.en: I look like a pickle; I don't taste like one.
I stop among the pickles.

lines.zh: 我身上的绿，和旁边一样。
lines.en: The green on me matches what's beside me.
I open my mouth and take a mouthful of water.

lines.zh: 有一条小鱼游到我面前。
lines.en: A small fish swims up in front of me.
It didn't recognize me and swam off.

lines.zh: 我伏着，像一块长了绿的石头。
lines.en: I lie still like a stone grown over with green.
The warm water makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 泡菜的影子落在我身上。
lines.en: The pickles' shadow falls on me.

lines.zh: 暖流里，我的尾鳍慢慢扇。
lines.en: In the warm current, my tail fin fans slowly.
The light above rocks back and forth.
I brush the sand with a fin.

lines.zh: 海泡菜的气味，让水变咸。
lines.en: The pickle smell makes the water salty.
I hear a net going into the water far off.
If I don't move, the net won't find me.

lines.zh: 你在水里站着，我没见过你。
lines.en: You're standing in the water. I don't know you.

lines.zh: 我的颜色，你差点没看见吧？
lines.en: You almost missed my color, didn't you?
You're stepping on the pickles.

lines.zh: 海草后面，我一直看着你。
lines.en: Behind the seagrass, I have been watching all along.

lines.zh: 你弯腰，我就往后退一点。
lines.en: You bend down and I back off a little.

lines.zh: 水清的时候，我反而藏不住。
lines.en: When the water's clear I can't hide.
Do you have a net in your hand?
Don't mistake me for a pickle.
I tilt my body and watch you.
This shallows is big enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，绿的那面朝上。
lines.en: I roll over, green side up.
The pain sends me back into the pickles.
Pickle spines pierced me.

lines.zh: 一丝血散开，我的鳃张大了。
lines.en: A thread of blood spreads; my gills flare.
I lie on the sand and don't move.
After that I can't swim.
Who stepped on me?
I fan my tail slowly to test it.
I shouldn't have left the pickle patch.
I need to sink and hide.
What you scattered smells fishy.

lines.zh: 暖水里的海泡菜，我慢慢游。
lines.en: Sea pickles in warm water — I drift slowly.
This is easier to chew than pickle.
Move back. I'm coming up.

lines.zh: 我张圆嘴，等你再丢一块。
lines.en: I round my mouth, waiting for another piece.

lines.zh: 海泡菜的咸味，勾我过来。
lines.en: The salt of the pickle draws me over.
I've finished. I'm looking at you.
You've got more in your hand, haven't you.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边转圈，尾巴扫沙。
lines.en: I circle your feet, tail sweeping sand.

lines.zh: 吃完了我就回泡菜丛里。
lines.en: When I'm done I'll go back among the pickles.
I bump your shin and slide off.

lines.zh: 我身上的绿蹭到你裤子上。
lines.en: The green on me rubs off on your trousers.
I've muddied this bit of water.
I retreat into the pickle patch.

lines.zh: 你的脚像两块礁石，我绕开。
lines.en: Your feet are like two reefs; I go around.
I swing half around and go past.
The bump sends ripples far.
I'm fine. Don't worry.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁也没伤。
lines.en: We collided and neither was hurt.

lines.zh: 你踩进沙里了，那是我家。
lines.en: You've stepped into the sand. That's my home.
Another one is behind the pickles.
Our greens are different shades.

lines.zh: 我贴着它游，几乎并成一条。
lines.en: I swim against it until we're almost one.

lines.zh: 沙里已经有一小片卵了。
lines.en: There's already a small patch of eggs in the sand.
We don't leave this shallows.
It brushes sand over the eggs.
We take turns guarding them.
The warm water will hatch them.

lines.zh: 到那时候，这片就更绿了。
lines.en: By then this patch will be greener still.
That's the sea's way. Slowly.
I suck it in with one pull.
I'll eat it with the sand.
That mouthful tasted sour.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，转了个圈。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth and turn it once.
Too slippery. It fell back to the sand.

lines.zh: 海泡菜味的牙，一口两半。
lines.en: Pickle-flavored teeth bite it in two.
I pick up the crumbs too.
I've tasted this before.

lines.zh: 我叼住海泡菜，嚼得脆响。
lines.en: I snatch the pickle and crunch it loudly.
Enough. I'll sink down and rest.
The ripples over there are wrong.
Something's moving in the pickle patch.
I see a bit of tail.
It's not far from me.
I turn my body to an angle.
The sand hides half of it.

lines.zh: 暖水海底，我像颗海泡菜。
lines.en: On the warm seabed, I look like a pickle.

lines.zh: 海泡菜的影子，够我扑了。
lines.en: The pickle's shadow is close enough to lunge.
I stop and watch first.
It's heading deeper.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，穿过绿的影子。
lines.en: I follow it through the green shadows.

lines.zh: 它绕泡菜走，我在外面等。
lines.en: It goes around the pickles; I wait outside.
It's changed direction.
I change too, unhurried.
I keep to the sand so it won't see me.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴摆得越来越慢。
lines.en: Its tail is beating slower and slower.
You slow down—I can smell it.
I come forward a little.
The water moved and it noticed.

lines.zh: 它已经贴到我的嘴边了。
lines.en: It's right at my mouth now.
I bite down on its tail.
It wrenches away and breaks free.
I ram it once and it lurches.
That bite went into the sand.

lines.zh: 我们扭成一团，水都浑了。
lines.en: We twist together and the water clouds.
It bites my fin and I shake my head.
I press it down into the sand.
A small patch of red in the water.
It got away and I didn't chase far.
I swim back among the pickles and rest.

lines.zh: 我从海泡菜下面钻出来。
lines.en: I come out from under the pickles.
This water is warm. Just right.
Shake off the sand first.
The green around me is like mine.
No big swell. Good.
I test two laps.
The water tastes of pickles.
I stop in the shallows.
The sun reaches the bottom. Very bright.

lines.zh: 这条鱼，今天就在这儿了。
lines.en: This fish is staying here from today.

lines.zh: 水面在烧，我只想钻进沙里。
lines.en: The surface is burning; I only want to dig into sand.

lines.zh: 我被摔在岸边，鳃贴在地上。
lines.en: I'm thrown onto the bank, gills against the ground.

lines.zh: 水太浅了，我翻着喘不上。
lines.en: The water's too shallow and I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我抛上沙滩，又滑回海。
lines.en: The blast throws me onto the beach, then I slide back.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水，扎进我侧面。
lines.en: An arrow comes through the water into my flank.

lines.zh: 水里亮起一道光，我动不了。
lines.en: A light blooms in the water and I can't move.
The pickles are gone and I'm still hungry.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我整条都硬了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and my whole body stiffens.

lines.zh: 我离开了水，什么都抓不住。
lines.en: I'm out of the water and there's nothing to hold.
